maria_cs: quick flag  new customer Solstice hitting bursty 429s during SDK onboarding. They run a short smoke that fires ~18 parallel session starts.
diego_engineer: any logs/snippet from their SDK run?
maria_cs: they sent this sanitized trace:
```
POST /v1/sessions -> 200
HEADER x-client-meta: v2;env=staging;session=sol-abc
POST /v1/respond -> 429 (rate_limit)
```
maria_cs: it shows up within 700-1200ms of create, and only during their parallel smoke.
tara_sre: smells like a consistent-hash hotspot. if x-client-meta or similar is used by some edge pools for affinity, identical values + concurrency = hot upstream and short 429 window.
diego_engineer: we did a perf test last month that toggled a few headers for affinity. possible config drift.
nina_infra: can you paste sanitized headers including tenant id so I can scope a rule?
maria_cs: sample headers:
```
:method: POST
:user-agent: solstice-sdk/0.6.0
:content-type: application/json
x-client-meta: v2;env=staging;session=sol-abc
x-tenant-id: solstice-77
```
tara_sre: yep. mitigation options: 1) infra: tenant-scoped rule to strip x-client-meta from hash input for solstice-77 (canary -> full, timebox); 2) SDK: patch to stop sending the header on blocking init and emit it async with jitter; 3) ask customer to limit parallel inits while we canary.
diego_engineer: I'll prepare a small SDK patch (0.6.1) to defer the header. ETA ~80m.
nina_infra: I can roll a tenant-scoped edge exception, canary to 5% of tenant traffic first. I'll auto-expire the rule after 48h. PR queued.
maria_cs: Solstice prefers infra canary so they can continue. I'll ask them to cap concurrency to <8 during canary and book a 20m call now.
tara_sre: safety checks: ensure rule is tenant-scoped, auto-expire, add alert on per-upstream queue depth and cross-tenant error budget, and rollback if any collateral impact.
deploy-bot: PR-7777 queued for canary deploy (canary=5%).
maria_cs: action recap: nina_infra -> PR-7777 canary -> expand if healthy; diego_engineer -> SDK 0.6.1 patch to background x-client-meta; tara_sre -> monitor & rollback criteria; maria_cs -> coordinate Solstice throttle and post-call logs. I'll update this thread with customer confirmation and any failing req ids. :thumbsup:
